examples.english: He is an inveterate gambler who has lost three houses at the casino.
examples.persian: او یک قمارباز ریشه‌دار و دیرینه است که سه خانه را در کازینو از دست داده است.

miniContext: He is an inveterate gambler who has lost three houses at the casino.

examples.english: The irascible old man yelled at anyone who stepped on his lawn.
examples.persian: آن پیرمرد زودخشم بر سر هر کسی که روی چمنش قدم می‌گذاشت فریاد می‌زد.

miniContext: The irascible old man yelled at anyone who stepped on his lawn.

examples.english: Her irreproachable conduct during the investigation impressed even her harshest critics.
examples.persian: رفتار بی‌عیب و نقص او در طول تحقیقات، حتی سخت‌گیرترین منتقدانش را هم تحت تأثیر قرار داد.

miniContext: Her irreproachable conduct during the investigation impressed even her harshest critics.

examples.english: A judicious investor spreads risk across several different markets.
examples.persian: یک سرمایه‌گذار سنجیده و عاقلانه، ریسک را میان چند بازار مختلف پخش می‌کند.

miniContext: A judicious investor spreads risk across several different markets.

examples.english: Asked how the meeting went, he gave a laconic reply: 'Fine.'
examples.persian: وقتی پرسیدند جلسه چطور بود، او پاسخی کم‌حرف و مختصر داد: «خوب بود.»

miniContext: Asked how the meeting went, he gave a laconic reply: 'Fine.'

examples.english: Donating half of his salary to the shelter was a truly laudable act.
examples.persian: بخشیدن نیمی از حقوقش به پناهگاه، کاری واقعاً شایسته تحسین بود.

miniContext: Donating half of his salary to the shelter was a truly laudable act.

examples.english: After the heavy lunch, the whole office felt lethargic for the rest of the afternoon.
examples.persian: پس از آن ناهار سنگین، تمام دفتر برای باقی بعدازظهر بی‌حال و کم‌انرژی شدند.

miniContext: After the heavy lunch, the whole office felt lethargic for the rest of the afternoon.

examples.english: The loquacious tour guide never stopped talking during the entire bus ride.
examples.persian: راهنمای تور پرحرف در طول کل سفر با اتوبوس لحظه‌ای از حرف زدن باز نایستاد.

miniContext: The loquacious tour guide never stopped talking during the entire bus ride.

examples.english: In a magnanimous gesture, the winner split the prize money with his opponent.
examples.persian: برنده در حرکتی بزرگوار و بخشنده، پول جایزه را با حریفش تقسیم کرد.

miniContext: In a magnanimous gesture, the winner split the prize money with his opponent.

examples.english: The villain's malevolent plan was to poison the entire town's water supply.
examples.persian: نقشه بدخواهانه آن شخصیت منفی، مسموم کردن منبع آب کل شهر بود.

miniContext: The villain's malevolent plan was to poison the entire town's water supply.

examples.english: Gold is prized by jewelers because it is so malleable when heated.
examples.persian: طلا به این دلیل نزد جواهرسازان ارزشمند است که وقتی گرم می‌شود بسیار انعطاف‌پذیر و شکل‌پذیر است.

miniContext: Gold is prized by jewelers because it is so malleable when heated.

examples.english: The company hired a maverick engineer who refused to follow standard procedures.
examples.persian: آن شرکت مهندسی مستقل و غیرمتعارف را استخدام کرد که از پیروی از روش‌های استاندارد سر باز می‌زد.

miniContext: The company hired a maverick engineer who refused to follow standard procedures.

examples.english: The river meanders slowly through the valley before reaching the sea.
examples.persian: رودخانه به‌آرامی و بی‌هدف از میان دره می‌گذرد پیش از آنکه به دریا برسد.

miniContext: The river meanders slowly through the valley before reaching the sea.

examples.english: The surgeon was meticulous, checking every instrument twice before the operation.
examples.persian: جراح بسیار دقیق بود و هر ابزار را دو بار پیش از عمل بررسی کرد.

miniContext: The surgeon was meticulous, checking every instrument twice before the operation.

examples.english: Planting trees along the riverbank can help mitigate flood damage.
examples.persian: کاشت درخت در کنار رودخانه می‌تواند به کاهش دادن شدت خسارات سیل کمک کند.

miniContext: Planting trees along the riverbank can help mitigate flood damage.

examples.english: The manager offered a refund to mollify the angry customer.
examples.persian: مدیر برای آرام کردن مشتری عصبانی، پیشنهاد بازپرداخت پول داد.

miniContext: The manager offered a refund to mollify the angry customer.

examples.english: He has been morose ever since his best friend moved to another city.
examples.persian: او از زمانی که بهترین دوستش به شهر دیگری نقل مکان کرد، عبوس و گرفته بوده است.

miniContext: He has been morose ever since his best friend moved to another city.

examples.english: The munificent billionaire funded an entire hospital wing anonymously.
examples.persian: آن میلیاردر بسیار بخشنده، به‌طور ناشناس هزینه یک بخش کامل بیمارستان را پرداخت کرد.

miniContext: The munificent billionaire funded an entire hospital wing anonymously.

examples.english: The detective slowly uncovered the businessman's nefarious scheme to defraud investors.
examples.persian: کارآگاه به‌تدریج نقشه شرورانه و خبیث آن تاجر برای کلاهبرداری از سرمایه‌گذاران را کشف کرد.

miniContext: The detective slowly uncovered the businessman's nefarious scheme to defraud investors.

examples.english: The babysitter was fired for being negligent about the children's safety.
examples.persian: پرستار بچه به خاطر سهل‌انگاری درباره امنیت کودکان اخراج شد.

miniContext: The babysitter was fired for being negligent about the children's safety.

examples.english: Despite failing the test, he remained nonchalant and shrugged it off.
examples.persian: با وجود قبول نشدن در امتحان، او خونسرد و بی‌اعتنا ماند و اهمیتی به آن نداد.

miniContext: Despite failing the test, he remained nonchalant and shrugged it off.

examples.english: The scandal brought him a kind of notoriety he never wanted.
examples.persian: آن رسوایی نوعی بدنامی برایش به همراه آورد که هرگز نمی‌خواست.

miniContext: The scandal brought him a kind of notoriety he never wanted.

examples.english: The scientist proposed a novel method for recycling plastic waste.
examples.persian: دانشمند روشی نو و بدیع برای بازیافت زباله‌های پلاستیکی پیشنهاد کرد.

miniContext: The scientist proposed a novel method for recycling plastic waste.

examples.english: Despite everyone's pleas, he remained obdurate and refused to change his mind.
examples.persian: با وجود التماس همه، او سرسخت و لجوج باقی ماند و از تغییر نظرش سر باز زد.

miniContext: Despite everyone's pleas, he remained obdurate and refused to change his mind.

examples.english: The company's lawyers used complicated jargon to obfuscate the contract's real terms.
examples.persian: وکلای شرکت از اصطلاحات پیچیده برای مبهم کردن شرایط واقعی قرارداد استفاده کردند.

miniContext: The company's lawyers used complicated jargon to obfuscate the contract's real terms.

examples.english: He walked straight into the glass door, oblivious to the warning sign.
examples.persian: او بی‌خبر و ناآگاه از تابلوی هشدار، مستقیم به در شیشه‌ای برخورد کرد.

miniContext: He walked straight into the glass door, oblivious to the warning sign.

examples.english: The obsequious waiter kept complimenting every customer to earn a bigger tip.
examples.persian: پیشخدمت چاپلوس و تملق‌گو دائماً از هر مشتری تعریف می‌کرد تا انعام بیشتری بگیرد.

miniContext: The obsequious waiter kept complimenting every customer to earn a bigger tip.

examples.english: Dark clouds gathered on the horizon, an ominous sign of the storm ahead.
examples.persian: ابرهای تیره در افق جمع شدند، نشانه‌ای شوم و تهدیدآمیز از طوفانی که در پیش بود.

miniContext: Dark clouds gathered on the horizon, an ominous sign of the storm ahead.

examples.english: Filing taxes for a small business can be an onerous task without an accountant.
examples.persian: پرداخت مالیات برای یک کسب‌وکار کوچک بدون حسابدار می‌تواند کاری سنگین و دشوار باشد.

miniContext: Filing taxes for a small business can be an onerous task without an accountant.

examples.english: The hotel lobby was opulent, with gold fixtures and crystal chandeliers.
examples.persian: سرسرای هتل مجلل و پرزرق‌وبرق بود، با وسایل طلایی و لوسترهای کریستالی.

miniContext: The hotel lobby was opulent, with gold fixtures and crystal chandeliers.
